notes.subject: חדשים / ימים
notes.rationale: Gĩgikũyũ kĩhũthagĩra mweri na mũthenya hamwe na namba ĩmwe, o ũrĩa Kihibirania kĩhũthagĩra — ciugo itigana kurũngwo kaundos.

notes.subject: mĩaka ĩnana · mĩthenya mithatũ ya mweri na ikũmi
notes.rationale: Kĩhooto kĩa arĩa moi mathĩna ma ũthurio wa mwathani.

notes.subject: mĩka ĩnana
notes.rationale: 2Maathani 36:9 kiuuga 'thamananya', o na Kiambĩrĩria 24:8 (2Am 36:9 LXX na BSB) kiuuga 'thamananya na ithano' — manugo meganĩte maatiganĩirwo.

notes.subject: thĩinĩ wa maitho ma Yahwe
notes.rationale: 'Bene-inĩ ma itho' nĩ kĩũro gĩa Gĩthurani kĩugaga 'kanaoneka mwĩhoko wa Yahwe'.

translation: Mwana wa mĩaka ĩnana Yehoyakini arĩ okiũrũkia, na mĩthenya mithatũ-inĩ ya mweri na ikũmi akĩũrũkia Yerucarayimu, na akĩgĩra ũru thĩinĩ wa maitho ma Yahwe.
